scope: Exactly four reviewed text fields; no numerical/mechanical changes

allowed_text_changes.before: 60-degree cone chills for 1.2s; normal enemies move at 65%. Bosses are marked, not slowed.
allowed_text_changes.after: Instant 60-degree cone chills for 1.2s; normal enemies move at 65%. Bosses mark-only. Weapon damage/rate/reach apply; projectile bonuses do not.
Weapon damage +15%; fixed module damage unchanged.

allowed_text_changes.before: Requires Cryo Sprayer + a different weapon type. Its surviving primary hit spends chill for 16 single-target secondary damage.
allowed_text_changes.after: Requires Cryo Sprayer + a different weapon type. Its surviving primary hit spends chill for fixed 16 secondary damage; weapon bonuses do not scale it.
